candidate.name: intraday_peak_amount_bar_recency_240m
candidate.mechanism: recency of the single strongest continuous-session trading-attention burst, retaining only the latest exact maximum amount-bar position
candidate.formula: latest zero-based position of the exact maximum among the 240 standard 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00 nonnegative finite amount bars, divided by 239

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Hold the maximum amount value and its latest bar position fixed while redistributing every nonmaximum bar amount without creating a new tie or maximum.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: intraday_amount_center_of_mass_240m, late_amount_share_30m, intraday_terminal_bar_amount_share_240m, AM/PM allocation, amount-profile similarity, and amount participation entropy

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Move the unique maximum amount from continuous-session bar i to adjacent bar i+1 while holding the complete multiset of 240 amount values fixed.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: total amount, maximum amount magnitude, concentration/entropy, and any permutation-invariant liquidity statistic

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Hold the complete minute amount path fixed while changing every minute and daily OHLC, VWAP, return, range, financial statement value, issuer event, and market-peer path.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: all price-path, volatility, return-state, transaction-price, accounting, event, peer-coupling, and Candidate49 mechanisms

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Create an exact maximum tie at an earlier bar while leaving the already-latest maximum unchanged.
Create a later exact maximum tie without changing the maximum magnitude or any price value.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: amount center of mass, maximum magnitude, price-extreme timing, and first-maximum representations

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_center_of_mass_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both encode when continuous-session amount was deployed
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: center of mass uses every bar amount as a weight; Campaign076 uses only the latest location of the exact maximum and is invariant to all nonmaximum redistribution that preserves the maximum

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: late_amount_share_30m and intraday_terminal_bar_amount_share_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: all can rise when attention concentrates late
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factors measure aggregate tail mass or exact terminal mass; Campaign076 may be high even when the late peak is small relative to broad earlier participation and may be low despite a large late-window aggregate

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_participation_entropy_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: a dominant peak can reduce distributional entropy
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: entropy is permutation-invariant and measures concentration; Campaign076 changes under a pure time permutation of the same amount multiset

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_extreme_arrival_order_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both locate an intraday extreme in time
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factor orders price extrema; Campaign076 reads no price and locates the maximum amount only
